اعترضن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَضْنَ (iʕtaraḍna) /iʕ.ta.radˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اُعْتُرِضْنَ (uʕturiḍna) /uʕ.tu.ridˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اِعْتَرِضْنَ (iʕtariḍna) /iʕ.ta.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
